async def act(page):
    # The 'Invite members' dialog is open from previous actions
    invite_dialog = page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Invite members')
    
    # Select the suggested user 'Abishek S abisubramanya27' from the menu
    menu_item = invite_dialog.get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('menuitem', name='Abishek S abisubramanya27')
    await menu_item.click()
    
    # Wait a moment for the selection to register and the submit button to become enabled
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Click the submit button to send the invite (it should now be enabled)
    submit_button = invite_dialog.get_by_role('button', name='Invite', exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the invite to process and the dialog to close
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
